request.style: English, lament, an old man's broken voice, almost spoken at times, a solo cello and a distant low horn, no drums, minor key, devastated, 50 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Good news for my lord the king
The Lord has delivered you today
Is it well with the young man Absalom
May all your enemies be like that young man

[Chorus]
O my son Absalom
My son, my son Absalom
Would I had died instead of you
O Absalom, my son, my son

[Verse]
The king was deeply moved
He went up to the chamber over the gate and wept
And as he went, he said
O my son

[Verse]
The victory that day was turned to mourning
The people stole into the city
As people steal in who are ashamed
The king covered his face and cried with a loud voice

[Chorus]
O my son Absalom
My son, my son Absalom
Would I had died instead of you
O Absalom, my son, my son
